notes.title: Multiplayer Testing! Now Live
notes.content:
So the latest build just went live, and with this... Multiplayer testing!

The multiplayer is in its very early stages and will require allot of testing, and will change allot over the next few weeks!
We look forward to hearing the feedback on multiplayer, and how it can be improved.

notes.title: Emergency HotFix
notes.content:
So this update comes a few days early, but this HotFix is being rolled out to address the issue with a memory leak that was causing the game to crash.

The update also includes a few visual fixes.

New Buildings are also included, but currently serve no purpose.

notes.title: Current Issues
notes.content:
Since launch a few issues have made themselves known. One of these issues is a graphics bug that causes textures to flicker, this has been fixed and will be included in the weekly patch!

Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Alpha version 0.1.6 is now live
notes.content:
This is the next patch launched for No Mans Land!

The following issues have been fixed 

-Loot Not spawning
-Zombies flying when hit with melee
-Players spawning dead

The following has been added
-Shopping mall
-Industrial district

notes.title: Store Page Live!
notes.content: So yesterday the store page went live! And with that we have a launch date! The latest patch will be available to all beta testers tonight, and on launch the rest of you will get a taste of the action!

notes.title: Multiplayer Delay and Bug Fix
notes.content:
So, to anyone who has played the Closed Beta will know that the game has allot of issues.
Currently the next patch aims to fix these issues.

Moving on, the next thing i would like to announce is the delay to multiplayer testing. Most of the back-end systems are being revamped, and due to this we dont want to throw out multiplayer that will be susceptible to several major changes, With that being said we do aim to have a multiplayer environment to test in the following weeks but our main focus now is to work on ironing out bugs, and implementing more finished content for beta testers to test.

As always,
Happy Hunting

notes.title: NoMansLand goes into Beta
notes.content:
Today marks no mans land going into Closed Beta. 
The kickstarter was successful and raised the funds to get NML onto steam. If anyone is interested in signing up for the Closed Beta, you will be able to complete a form posted soon to apply.

Happy Hunting.
